source.title: Pikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 6Comic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceGamesPikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyReleases 11/12/26Select a versionNintendo Switch 2Nintendo SwitchUpgrade PackWhat's an upgrade pack?Select an editionPhysical - Pikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyComic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceQuantity1LoadingFind retailersNintendo Switch 2 features• Enhance your expedition with improved visuals for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.• Sharpen your command of Pikmin in a series of exams at Dandori Academy.• Give voice commands to Oatchi, your dependable space dog, using the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone.• Challenge your friends in Dandori Battles, even if they don’t have the game, via GameShare** locally or online via GameChat.Guide pint-sized creatures in an endearing expedition!Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures with distinct abilities that you can grow, pluck, guide, and overpower enemies with! Use your Pikmin’s miniature might (and a bit of strategy) to explore this mysterious planet in search of your crew—and treasure.Play the trailer.Three stages of Pikmin stand side by side, each with something growing from the stem on their heads: a budding Blue Pikmin, a flowering Yellow Pikmin, and a leafy Red Pikmin.Lead your loyal and curious squadTo succeed, you’ll have to balance caring for the Pikmin with leading them into dangerous situations. Do your best out there!Two Red Pikmin, a Yellow Pikmin, a Blue Pikmin, and a Winged Pikmin move in a line.The Red Pikmin towards the back of the line has tripped forward onto their face.GrowPikmin grow from pellets and wildlife that you can bring to your ship. Pluck them from the ground to have them join you. Go team!GuideLead your squad through vast explorable areas to find treasures, discover new paths, and battle enemies of all sizes. You can also direct the Pikmin to collect and carry resources that are helpful for your mission. Up to three Pikmin types can be with you in the field at a time—the rest will hang back until you need them.GatherWhen their task is done, the Pikmin will wait in place for you. Get close and blow your whistle to summon them to your side! This handy action can also help you protect the Pikmin from danger, do a headcount, or simply bring them with you to your next task.Meet the PikminA mysterious mix of plant and animal, these creatures are loyal, clever, and ready to follow your lead. Be sure to call forward the right ones for the job!Switch to the previous type of Pikmin.Switch to the next type of Pikmin.Red PikminFire is no sweat to these feisty creatures. Red Pikmin make a strong first line of attack.Blue PikminHappy on land and in water. When the going gets wet, fling them into action to transport treasure or combat a creature.Yellow PikminShockingly great at smashing electrified gates or directing currents. They can dig really well and get awesome air when thrown, too.Ice PikminThese cool new buds can freeze enemies in their tracks. They can also freeze a body of water, allowing others to cross.Glow PikminThese strange new Pikmin thrive in the dark, but can also turn into a ball of light so shiny, it can stun enemies!Purple PikminWhoa—a single Purple Pikmin has the strength and weight of 10 regular Pikmin! Because of this extra oomph, Purple Pikmin can stun enemies when thrown and carry heavier objects. It also makes them slower on their feet.Rock PikminThese sturdy Pikmin are heavy and unbreakable—perfect for smashing crystals or dealing with large, stompy enemies.Winged PikminHigh-flying Pikmin that can carry stuff over water and lift obstructions. They’re also good at battling enemies that can fly.White PikminCareful—these speedy little ones are poisonous! On the plus side, they can take on toxic environments better than others.Red PikminBlue PikminYellow PikminIce PikminGlow PikminPurple PikminRock PikminWinged PikminWhite PikminActive gallery item: 2 of 9.The Rescue Corps needs you!Customize your own explorer and lead the charge each day to find your crew and fix the Rescue Corps ship, the S.S. Shepherd.Track down your crew—and othersFind and rescue your Rescue Corps crew and other castaways who find themselves in a bind.Explore cavesStrategize your way through multiple floors of puzzles and critters. Time seems to work differently when you’re exploring caves, so there’s no need to rush.Collect resourcesTreasures are a great source of Sparklium, the mysterious element that powers the S.S. Shepherd. You can also collect raw materials that are handy for construction in the field, or build new equipment to make exploring more manageable!Rescue Command PostTake your time to prepare for the day’s excursion! You can chat with Rescue Corps members and castaways, accept side missions, and build new equipment to assist you on your expedition. You can also choose to go on Night Expeditions from here.Who’s a good Oatchi? Oh, yes you are!Resident good boy and dependable partner Oatchi can help get the job done throughout your adventure. You can even train this Rescue Pup to become more helpful!With the Pikmin and a powerful pup at your side, no challenge is too big!Giddyup!Your explorer and Pikmin can hop on Oatchi’s back for a ride. Plus, Oatchi can jump!Clear obstaclesThis pup is more than happy to create a path forward by digging and smashing through parts of the environment.Go fetchOatchi can retrieve stuff and drag it back to where you need it. Drop. Droooooop. Good boy!Divide and conquerIf you need to split up, you can give orders to Oatchi to take care of business elsewhere.Go to the previous Oatchi ability.Go to the next Oatchi ability.Giddyup!Clear obstaclesGo fetchDivide and conquerActive gallery item: 1 of 4.Tricks of the tradeEvery in-game day brings different adventures, but there’s only so much you can do before you must return to the safety of your ship at night. Remember: If you can’t get everything done that you wanted, there’s always tomorrow.Rewind and retrySomething go si

source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Blood, Language, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceGamesMetaphor: ReFantazioReleases 11/12/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Metaphor: ReFantazioBlood, Language, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceLoadingView DLCFrom the creators of Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, an award-winning RPG, AWAKENED on Nintendo Switch™ 2! Praised worldwide for its narrative, game design, and combat system, Metaphor: ReFantazio is an RPG masterpiece. With a Metascore of 94 and over 50 prestigious awards, including 'Best RPG' at The Game Awards 2024, the next evolution of fantasy RPG is here on Nintendo Switch™ 2!Enter the royal tournament to fight for the throne and for the future. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical “Archetype” powers that lie dormant in your heart. Team up with a compelling cast of characters and embark on an immersive journey that promises hours of captivating exploration, dynamic turn-based with a blend of real-time combat, and exhilarating discovery.Key Features:-Fantasy RPG: A mysterious & exciting story unfolds in a world where people must fight their own anxiety. Join the high-stakes Royal Tournament that promises hours of captivating exploration and discovery. -Award-winning Art Direction: Ride your “gauntlet runner” to faraway dungeons & towns across an expansive world. Discover beautiful landscapes accompanied by captivating music, immersive UI, ＆ anime cutscenes.-Innovative Battle System: An exhilarating turn-based combat system with a blend of real time action. Party customization through "Archetype" powers provides the freedom to personalize your adventures. -Time Management System: Go on quests, dungeon dive, & hunt for treasures by day. Strengthen relationships, build bonds, & increase virtues by night. Choose your actions wisely, time management is key to achieving your goal. Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Pre-order now to unlock exclusive in-game consumable item sets, designed to aid you on your epic adventure wherever your journey takes you.■Product Details ・Metaphor: ReFantazio Archetype EXP Chest Set ・Metaphor: ReFantazio Adventurer’s Journey Pack■Set Details Archetype EXP Chest Set・10x Hero's Incenses (Increases Archetype Experiences by 100)・5x Hero's Fruits (Increases Archetype Experiences by 500)Adventurer’s Journey Pack・30,000 Reeve (In-game currency)・5x Expensive Medicines (Restores 200 HP to one ally)・5x Revival Medicines (Revives an ally)・3x Magical Breads (Gradually recover MP while in dungeon)・2x Stale Blackbreads (Deals 300 Almighty damage to one enemy)*After downloading this DLC, you can receive it at the in-game facility "Akademeia."*Available for purchase until November 11, 2026 (Wednesday) at 8:59 PM (PT).Related tagsRole playingChoose your difficultyRaise your statsVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)62.1 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedAccessibility featuresSurround SoundDifficulty LevelsPlayable without Motion ControlsPlayable without Rapid Button PressesPlayable without Touch ControlsLearn more about the Accessible Games Initiative’s tag descriptions.Nintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
